proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING PAY GAP REPORT
proposals.proponent: Arjuna Capital, on behalf of Clark Freifeld and Andee Krasner, and Proxy Impact, on behalf of the Marguerite Casey Foundation
proposals.topic_summary: Requests Oracle report on quantitative median and adjusted pay gaps across race and gender, including associated policy, reputational, competitive, and operational risks.
proposals.evidence: the Board unanimously recommends a vote AGAINST adoption of Proposal No. 6.

proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING INDEPENDENT BOARD CHAIRMAN
proposals.proponent: John Chevedden, on behalf of Kenneth Steiner
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the Board adopt a policy and amend governing documents to require the Chairman of the Board be an independent director.
proposals.evidence: The Board unanimously recommends a vote AGAINST adoption of Proposal No. 7.
